title: 第1158章 荀老第1157章 剑玄主
content_zh:
下河谷
天际之上苍青巨龙正被一条条金色光丝不断包裹很快便如同一个金色蚕蛹
“不好，龙子有危险”
古玄宗第一个反应过来但他根本无法上前，几乎就在他有所动作之时一只浑身冒着鲜血的八臂魔神便拦在了他的身前
八只拳头如同炮弹一般将古玄宗死死地压制
与此同时原本重伤倒地的红胡子也再次暴起化作一头巨型烈焰雄狮扑向古玄宗
“老夫可没时间陪你们胡闹”
眼见二人再度形成夹击之势古玄宗双目微合双掌之间
一道棕黄灵光猛然亮起，在其掌心间一颗不规则满是凹陷的石头逐渐浮现而出
道道黄沙果位意象包围着古玄宗让他仿佛化身黄沙之主，入目所及皆是黄沙漫天
与此同时自古玄宗周深正有大量的沙土汇聚而来，不断朝着其掌心中间的那颗小石头汇聚
“便让尔等尝尝。老夫这收蓄重土的滋味如何吧？
说罢古玄宗将手中那颗小石子抛出
“嗡！
顷刻之间无数沙石土块飞速朝着这颗小石子汇聚甚至就连血蛊魔君召唤而出的八臂魔神那庞大的身躯也被吸了上去接着无数沙石将之包裹覆盖其中
这道神通覆盖面积极广，也没有什么敌我之分
一些同盟修士虽隔得数十里老远，但修为不够稳不住身形照样吸入其中
一时之间，妖兽、人、石头、树木、山川、河流，皆被带上高空化为石球的一部分
这个过程持续快速眨眼间天空之上便形成了一颗直径数里的巨大石球并且还在不断增大，其中散发的热量与噪音更是达到令人窒息的地步
“古施主你一个鬼岛修士为了龙宫，你有必要这么拼吗？

却在此时一道女子的妖娆声音响起
只见云层之中一道莲花宝座之上，正有一道曼妙的白纱倩影站在莲心
此女头戴重楼宝冠秀发如瀑披着一袭洁白轻纱，一袭宽大道袍包裹着玲珑娇躯，手中端着一个琉璃宝瓶
说话间明眸皓齿之间露出的满是慈悲之相，可在这层慈悲之下又隐隐有着一丝妩媚
“广贤这里没你净土的事，最好滚一边去”
古玄宗面色阴冷说道
“她就是广贤琉璃菩萨，净土昙华女释的圣女！
黄书生和儿子黄小飞躲在一块巨石后面大气不敢出
他们可不敢多看，修为越高的女修脾气越怪，搞不好被定下个视奸的罪可就完犊了
“呵呵，古施主所言差矣，我佛有云上天有好生之德，你们鬼岛修士这般作恶多端，我净土怎可坐视不理”
广贤琉璃菩萨丝毫不让笑道
“那你就一起去死吧”
古玄宗不与其争论挥手间漫天黄沙自广贤菩萨周身扬起将之飞速包裹
只是不等黄沙继续汇集，娇俏菩萨的身影便化作了一块木雕，接着其上长出了枝芽并迅速化作一颗参天大树
“阿弥陀佛，施主回头是岸”
广贤琉璃菩萨双手合十脚步轻盈出现在了大树之上
同时这位菩萨手中的琉璃瓶中倒出道道清泉，这些纯净的泉水冲击在土球之上竟让之产生了龟裂，被困其中的血蛊魔君与红胡子当即便脱困而出
“速去保护龙子”
古玄宗知道托身不得朝着龙宫护卫们喝道
此刻的龙子情况可谓不容乐观，金丝早已将之包裹成一个巨茧谁也不知其中情况如何
content_en:
lower valley
The huge green dragon above the sky is being wrapped by golden threads, and soon it looks like a golden silkworm chrysalis.
"No, Ryuko is in danger."
Gu Xuanzong was the first to react, but he couldn't step forward at all. Almost as soon as he made a move, an eight-armed demon with blood all over his body stopped in front of him.
The eight fists suppressed Gu Xuanzong like cannonballs.
At the same time, Red Beard, who had been seriously injured and fell to the ground, suddenly rose up again and turned into a giant flaming lion and rushed towards Gu Xuanzong.
"I don't have time to fool around with you."
Seeing the two of them once again forming a pincer attack, Gu Xuanzong's eyes were slightly closed between his palms.
A brown-yellow spiritual light suddenly lit up, and an irregular and sunken stone gradually emerged from his palm.
The images of yellow sand surrounding Gu Xuanzong made him seem to be the lord of yellow sand, and the sky was filled with yellow sand as far as he could see.
At the same time, a large amount of sand and soil have been gathering since ancient Xuanzong Zhou Shen, and they are constantly gathering towards the small stone in the middle of his palm.
"I'll let you guys have a taste. How does it feel to collect so much soil?"
After saying that, Gu Xuanzong threw out the pebble in his hand
“Buzz!
In an instant, countless sand, stone and soil quickly gathered towards this small stone. Even the huge body of the eight-armed demon summoned by the Blood Gu Demon Lord was sucked up, and then countless sand and stones wrapped it up and covered it.
This magical power covers a very wide area, and there is no distinction between friend and foe.
Although some of the alliance monks were separated by tens of miles, they were still inhaled because they were not strong enough to stabilize their bodies.
Suddenly, monsters, people, stones, trees, mountains, and rivers were all carried high into the sky and became part of the stone ball.
This process continued rapidly and in the blink of an eye, a huge stone ball with a diameter of several miles was formed in the sky and was still growing. The heat and noise emitted from it reached a suffocating level.
"Gu Don, you, a monk from Ghost Island, do you have to fight so hard for Dragon Palace?
But at this moment, a woman's enchanting voice sounded
I saw a graceful white gauze silhouette standing on a lotus throne among the clouds.
This woman wears a heavy crown, her hair is like a waterfall, she is dressed in pure white gauze, she is wearing a wide robe that wraps her delicate body, and she is holding a glass vase in her hand.
The look between his bright eyes and white teeth as he spoke was full of compassion, but underneath this layer of compassion there was a hint of charm.
"Guangxian has nothing to do with your Pure Land. It's best to get out of here."
Gu Xuanzong said with a cold expression
"She is Guangxian Liuli Bodhisattva, the saint of Pure Land Tanhua Nvshi!
Huang Shusheng and his son Huang Xiaofei were hiding behind a huge rock, not daring to come out.
They didn't dare to look further. The higher the cultivation level, the weirder the temper of the female cultivator. She might be convicted of rape and that would be the end of it.
"Haha, what the ancient benefactor said is wrong. My Buddha has clouds in the sky and has the virtue of a good life. You ghost island monks are doing so many evil things. How can our Pure Land just sit back and ignore it?"
Guangxian Liuli Bodhisattva refused to laugh at all.
"Then you go to die together"
Ancient Xuanzong did not argue with him, and with his hand, the sky was covered with yellow sand, which flew up from Guangxian Bodhisattva's body and quickly enveloped it.
But before the yellow sand continued to gather, the figure of the charming Bodhisattva turned into a wooden sculpture, and then branches sprouted from it and quickly turned into a towering tree.
"Amitabha, the benefactor will be safe when he comes back"
Guangxian Liuli Bodhisattva clasped his hands together and appeared on the big tree with light steps.
At the same time, clear springs poured out from the glass bottle in the hands of the Bodhisattva. The impact of these pure spring water on the earth ball actually caused cracks in it. The Blood Gu Demon Lord and Red Beard who were trapped in it escaped immediately.
"Go quickly and protect Ryuko"
Ancient Xuanzong knew not to shout at the Dragon Palace guards
The current situation of Longzi is not optimistic. The golden thread has already wrapped him into a giant cocoon. No one knows what is going on inside.
